_comment: Lucy upgradable model manifest. DATA, not code — add a model here and every device picks it up on next launch, no app update. Each id MUST exist in WebLLM's prebuiltAppConfig.model_list (validated at runtime; unknown ids are silently dropped). tier: baseline=runs anywhere incl. mobile (3B locked floor); desktop/workstation=bigger brains, never offered on mobile (browser sandbox ceiling — those unlock in the Electron desktop build). Gates: needsF16 (WebGPU shader-f16), minDeviceMemoryGB (Chrome/Android/desktop only), minGpuBufferGB (real weight-size ceiling), approxGB (also gated against free storage).

models.label: Lucy 3B · universal
models.note: Runs everywhere incl. iOS Safari (no f16 needed). The locked phone floor.

models.label: Lucy 3B · fast
models.note: Smaller + faster where WebGPU shader-f16 is available (most Android/desktop).

models.label: Lucy 8B · desktop
models.note: Stronger reasoning on a capable desktop/laptop GPU. Not offered on mobile (browser ceiling).

models.label: Lucy 8B · desktop (fast)
models.note: f16 desktop build — fastest 8B where shader-f16 is supported.
